featured_reviews.review_text:
This store is having huge variety of options, yet most of their items are slightly damaged eg. broken / damaged / very old stuff / unsold items in poor packaging

I’m a regular buyer from Astoria, but i had experienced that though their product / items are old, broken or damaged their prices are still high nor any discounts given on such products.

I happened to buy a product which was a good piece but after u boxing at home it was a damaged piece, I got my refund as they didn’t had a replacement of the same item.

I would suggest and recommend everyone to please check every item while purchasing and to check battery operated items as they don’t function and are mostly in same condition.

About pricing i would say few option are only reasonable and there’s hardly any price difference from other stores nearby .

featured_reviews.name: Mehak jain
featured_reviews.review_text:
Very disappointing experience at Astoria Store.

Firstly, the person at the billing counter was extremely rude and unprofessional. The rest of the staff was also very rude and unhelpful.

We wanted to purchase 15 diffusers and requested the lady to help us get them. Her response was, “I’ve told him to get it. Yeh toh mera kaam hai bhi nahi, fir bhi kar rahi hu,” which was completely inappropriate. As customers making a bulk purchase, we expected basic courtesy.

We had a full shopping cart worth over ₹3000 and even requested assistance to carry it downstairs since it was very heavy, but no help was provided at all.

To top it off, after such a large bill, they additionally charged ₹10 for a carry bag. How is someone supposed to take their goods home after spending so much? The least they could do is provide basic support and service.

Overall, not a hospitable place at all. Very disappointing experience.
